entities.summary: Shin Dong-bin (b. 1955-02-14, Tokyo) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tokyo and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, merchants & economists, asia.
